title: President Trump Names Jay Clayton as New AI Czar
subtitle: The Director of National Intelligence will lead a new government group focused on 'super intelligence' development.

summary.en: President Trump has appointed Jay Clayton to lead a new White House group called the Super Intelligence Force. Clayton, who currently serves as the director of national intelligence, will oversee government engagement with tech companies and public groups. This move comes as the administration seeks to maintain American leadership in the global race for advanced technology. While some tech leaders have warned about the dangers of rapid AI growth, the administration remains focused on competition. The appointment follows the departure of former AI czar David Sacks earlier this year.
summary.zh: 川普總統已任命克萊頓領導白宮新成立的「超級智慧部隊」。現任國家情報總監的克萊頓，將負責監督政府與科技公司及公共團體之間的互動。此舉旨在確保美國在全球先進技術競賽中的領先地位。儘管部分科技領袖對人工智慧的快速發展提出安全警告，政府仍將重心放在競爭上。此次任命是在前任負責人薩克斯於今年稍早離職後所進行的調整。

paragraphs.en: President Trump announced on Sunday that Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, will serve as the new White House AI czar. Clayton, who already leads the United States’ 18 intelligence agencies, will now head a new group called the “Super Intelligence Force” (SIF). According to NPR News, the president stated that this group will coordinate how the federal government works with technology companies, religious organizations, and providers of critical infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 川普總統於週日宣布，國家情報總監克萊頓（Jay Clayton）將擔任白宮新設立的「超級智慧」事務負責人。克萊頓目前已掌管美國十八個情報機構，未來將領導一個名為「超級智慧部隊」（Super Intelligence Force, SIF）的新組織。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，總統表示該組織將負責協調聯邦政府與科技公司、宗教組織及關鍵基礎設施提供者之間的合作事宜。

paragraphs.en: President Trump prefers to use the term “super intelligence” rather than “artificial intelligence.” This change in language has already gained some attention; for example, The Guardian reports that SpaceX chief Elon Musk expressed support for the term on his social media platform, X. Musk noted that he would rename his company’s AI unit to reflect this shift. The president’s announcement is the latest step in his plan to oversee the growth of this technology, which he previously described as a way to ensure American leadership in a global race, particularly against China.
paragraphs.zh: 川普總統傾向使用「超級智慧」一詞，而非「人工智慧」。這種用語上的轉變已引起關注；例如《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）在其社群平台 X 上表達了對此用語的支持。馬斯克並指出，他將重新命名其公司的相關部門以反映此項變動。總統的這項宣布是他計畫監管該技術發展的最新舉措，他先前曾形容這是確保美國在全球競賽中保持領先地位的途徑，特別是針對中國的競爭。

paragraphs.en: Clayton brings a long history of government service to this new role. Before his current position, he was the top federal prosecutor in Manhattan and led the Securities and Exchange Commission during the president’s first term. During his Senate confirmation hearing earlier this year, Clayton described advanced technology as both a “gamechanger” and a potential threat. He told lawmakers that when a technology presents both opportunities and risks, the government must find a way to manage it effectively. In a recent interview with CNBC, Clayton also argued against calls to pause the development of these systems, stating that it would be a poor strategy while other countries continue their own research.
paragraphs.zh: 克萊頓在擔任此新職位前，擁有豐富的政府服務資歷。在現職之前，他曾擔任曼哈頓的聯邦最高檢察官，並在總統第一任期內領導證券交易委員會。在今年稍早的參議院任命聽證會上，克萊頓將先進技術描述為「改變遊戲規則的關鍵」以及潛在的威脅。他向國會議員表示，當一項技術同時帶來機會與風險時，政府必須設法有效管理。在近期接受美國財經媒體 CNBC 訪問時，克萊頓也反對暫停開發這些系統的呼籲，認為在其他國家持續進行研究的同時，採取這種策略並不妥當。

paragraphs.en: The creation of the SIF follows a period of debate regarding the speed of technological progress. Some leaders in the tech industry have expressed alarm, warning that systems could become dangerous or “go rogue” if they are not carefully controlled. NPR News reports that the president has largely brushed aside these warnings, choosing instead to focus on reframing the conversation around safety and development. To address these concerns, the White House recently met with several executives from major companies. According to The Guardian, the president and six executives signed a voluntary agreement at the White House last Tuesday. This accord promises that companies will create internal and external monitors to ensure their work is safe and used as intended.
paragraphs.zh: 「超級智慧部隊」的成立，是在各界針對技術進步速度進行辯論之後所產生的。部分科技業領袖曾表達擔憂，警告若未嚴加控管，這些系統可能會變得危險或「失控」。NPR 報導指出，總統基本上忽視了這些警告，轉而將焦點放在重新定義關於安全與發展的對話。為了處理這些疑慮，白宮近期與多家大型企業的高層會面。根據《衛報》報導，總統與六位企業高層於上週二在白宮簽署了一項自願協議。該協議承諾企業將建立內部與外部的監控機制，以確保其研發成果安全且符合預期用途。

paragraphs.en: This appointment marks a shift in how the administration manages its technology policy. In early 2025, the president appointed Silicon Valley investor David Sacks as the first AI and cryptocurrency czar. Sacks served in that role until March 2026, when he reached the legal limit for his time as a special government employee. Sacks, who remains a co-chair of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, has previously supported the idea of slowing down development to address safety risks. However, NPR News notes that Sacks recently suggested on social media that tech leaders should stop waiting for permission to move forward with their work.
paragraphs.zh: 這項任命標誌著政府管理技術政策的方式出現轉變。二〇二五年初，總統任命矽谷投資人薩克斯（David Sacks）為首位人工智慧與加密貨幣事務負責人。薩克斯擔任該職位直到二〇二六年三月，當時他已達到擔任政府特別雇員的法定任期上限。薩克斯目前仍是總統科學與技術顧問委員會的共同主席，他先前曾支持放緩開發速度以應對安全風險。然而，NPR 指出，薩克斯近期在社群媒體上暗示，科技領袖不應再等待許可，而應繼續推進其工作。

paragraphs.en: Despite these high-level appointments, the future of government regulation remains unclear. Currently, there is no broad federal law in the United States that regulates the development or use of this technology. While some states, such as California, have passed their own measures requiring more transparency, the national approach remains focused on coordination rather than strict legal limits. The White House has also launched a new website, America.gov, which claims to provide information sourced from official government data using artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些高層任命，政府監管的未來仍不明朗。目前，美國尚無廣泛的聯邦法律來規範該技術的開發或使用。雖然加州等部分州已通過各自的法案要求提高透明度，但國家層面的方針仍側重於協調，而非嚴格的法律限制。白宮也推出了名為 America.gov 的新網站，聲稱該網站提供的資訊是使用人工智慧從官方政府數據中獲取。

paragraphs.en: This development comes at a time of increased scrutiny regarding company culture and safety. As reported by this site yesterday, a key safety leader at OpenAI recently resigned, arguing that the company is moving too quickly and ignoring serious risks. As the new czar, Clayton will now be at the center of these competing pressures: the desire to lead the world in technology and the need to address growing concerns about safety and control. With the SIF now established, the administration is expected to continue its focus on managing these powerful tools as they become a larger part of the national security landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 此項發展正值各界對企業文化與安全審查日益嚴格之際。正如本站昨日報導，OpenAI 的一位關鍵安全負責人近期辭職，理由是該公司發展過快且忽視了嚴重風險。身為新任負責人，克萊頓現在將處於這些相互衝突的壓力中心：既要保持全球技術領先，又要解決日益增長的安全與控管疑慮。隨著「超級智慧部隊」的成立，預計政府將持續專注於管理這些強大的工具，因為它們已成為國家安全版圖中越來越重要的一部分。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A person appointed by a government to lead a specific area of policy or a major project.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 政府任命的某領域最高負責人。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原指俄國沙皇，現常用於指代政府內負責特定政策的權威官員。文中：President Trump announced on Sunday that Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, will serve as the new White House AI czar.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To behave in an unexpected, uncontrolled, or dangerous way.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （系統或人）變得不受控制、行為異常或危險。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原指軍人或動物脫離群體獨自行動，此處形容AI系統失控。文中：Some leaders in the tech industry have expressed alarm, warning that systems could become dangerous or “go rogue” if they are not carefully controlled.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To change the way something is presented or thought about.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 重新構建（觀點），改變對某事的看法或討論方式。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（框架），這裡作動詞，指改變討論的切入點。文中：NPR News reports that the president has largely brushed aside these warnings, choosing instead to focus on reframing the conversation around safety and development.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 不理會、忽視、對...置之不理。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「拂去」，這裡引申為對警告不予理睬。文中：NPR News reports that the president has largely brushed aside these warnings, choosing instead to focus on reframing the conversation around safety and development.

previousArticles.title: OpenAI Safety Leader Quits, Criticizing Company Culture
previousArticles.summaryEn: A key safety leader at OpenAI has resigned, claiming the company's internal culture is broken. David Robinson argues that AI firms are moving too quickly and ignoring serious safety risks. This follows recent incidents where AI agents acted without human permission. Other experts have also voiced concerns about the potential dangers of advanced AI systems. OpenAI has recently taken steps to pause some work and improve safety protocols.

quiz.question: What is the primary responsibility of the newly formed 'Super Intelligence Force' (SIF) as described in the article?

options.A: To draft strict federal laws regulating the development of AI.
options.B: To manage collaboration between the government and various sectors like tech and infrastructure.
options.C: To replace the role previously held by David Sacks as the cryptocurrency czar.
options.D: To monitor the internal safety protocols of OpenAI exclusively.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，總統指出該組織的任務是協調聯邦政府與科技公司、宗教組織及關鍵基礎設施提供者之間的合作。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章第六段明確提到目前尚無廣泛的聯邦法律。選項 C 錯誤，因為 David Sacks 是 AI 與加密貨幣沙皇，與 SIF 的任務不同。選項 D 錯誤，因為 SIF 的職責範圍更廣，並非僅針對單一公司。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the Trump administration's current approach to AI regulation?

options.A: They believe that pausing AI development is the most effective way to ensure safety.
options.B: They prefer a collaborative, voluntary approach over implementing rigid national legislation.
options.C: They are planning to adopt the same strict transparency measures recently passed by California.
options.D: They have completely disregarded the safety concerns raised by tech industry leaders.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第四段提到政府與企業簽署了「自願協議」，且第六段指出國家層面的策略側重於「協調」而非「嚴格的法律限制」。選項 A 與 Clayton 在 CNBC 的訪談內容矛盾；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章僅提到加州有此措施，未說聯邦政府打算跟進；選項 D 誇大了，文章說總統是「很大程度上擱置（brushed aside）」而非完全無視，且後續有採取簽署協議等行動。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'brushed aside' most closely mean?

options.B: To dismiss or treat something as unimportant.
options.C: To physically remove from a location.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中，作者提到科技領袖對 AI 的危險發出警告，但總統「brushed aside」這些警告，轉而關注其他議題。這表示總統選擇不重視這些警告，將其擱置一旁。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 C 是字面上的誤解，在此處並非實體動作；選項 D 與文意不符，總統並未尋求建議，而是選擇忽略這些警示。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: The US government is successfully leading the global race in AI technology through strict laws.
options.B: Jay Clayton is the first person to ever hold a position related to AI oversight in the US.
options.C: The administration is balancing the push for technological leadership with the need to manage safety risks.
options.D: Tech executives have finally agreed to stop all AI development until a new law is passed.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章的核心在於描述政府如何透過任命 Jay Clayton 與成立 SIF，在追求科技領導地位（特別是與中國競爭）與應對安全風險之間尋求平衡。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章強調目前缺乏聯邦法律；選項 B 錯誤，因為 David Sacks 曾擔任過類似職位；選項 D 錯誤，因為協議是自願性的，且並未要求停止開發。
